english.title: Remove goods subject to an import prohibition / restriction with intent to evade the prohibition / restriction
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..),

(A)_[removed]_
(B)_[assisted in the removal of]_
(C)_[were concerned in the removal of]_

goods, namely **(..SPECIFY THE GOODS..), the importation, landing or unloading of which was

(D)_[prohibited]_
(E)_[restricted]_

by **(..SPECIFY THE ENACTMENT..) from

(F)_[their place of importation]_
(G)_[an approved wharf]_
(H)_[an examination station]_
(I)_[a transit shed]_
(J)_[a customs and excise station]_

at **(..SPECIFY THE PLACE OF REMOVAL..), with intent to evade the

(K)_[prohibition]_
(L)_[restriction]_

Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

other.penalty:
Summary: Six months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding £20,000 or of three times the value of the goods whichever is the greater.
Indictment: Seven years imprisonment and / or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
Complex

libra.complexpenaltydetails: The financial penalty on summary conviction is £20,000 or of three times the value of the goods whichever is the greater
